title: Ike's Morning Digest
data_note: Built from publisher RSS metadata (titles + teaser text). `coverage_window_hours` is the default (40h); several feeds use a longer `rollingHours` (see `scripts/build-digest.mjs`) so rows align with what is still on each publisher’s listing pages. Commercial Observer keeps its retail category + hub supplement; TRD adds a New York–filtered global retail tag feed. PincusCo uses the live site feed only (`/category/retail/feed/` is stale). **CRE Daily** retail briefs come from `credaily.com/sectors/retail/feed/`. **WSJ** is the Dow Jones real-estate feed with lifestyle and opinion dropped. **The New York Times** keeps real-estate and property stories only. **Traded** is commercial deal briefs from its news listing. Open each link for the full article (subscriptions may apply in the browser).

PNC Bank Inks 4K-SF Retail Lease at 312 West 43rd Street: Residents at the Ellery , a mixed-use residential development in Manhattan’s Hell’s Kitchen neighborhood, are getting another retailer at the base of their 33-story home. PNC Bank has signed a 3,500-square-foot retail lease at the base of the property at 312 West 43rd Street , according to co-developers and co-owners.

AT&T Renews 7K-SF Lease at Rudin’s 3 Times Square: Home is where the heart is, and telecommunications giant AT&T is quite at home in the heart of Times Square . The wireless carrier has renewed and extended its lease at Rudin ’s 3 Times Square for another five years, Commercial Observer has learned.

TJ Maxx Signs 29K-SF Deal to Replace H&M at 150 East 86th Street: Discount department store T.J. Maxx is replacing H&M in a busy retail spread on Manhattan’s Upper East Side, Commercial Observer has learned.

Camera Brand Fujifilm Takes 13K SF at 210 Lafayette Street in SoHo: A Japanese camera manufacturer is setting up shop in Manhattan’s photogenic SoHo neighborhood. Fujifilm signed a lease for 12,700 square feet at Comjem Associates ’ 210 Lafayette Street for what could be a brick-and-mortar retail location similar to stores operated by B&H or Adorama .

items.headline: Hines Says Retail Recovery Is an Income and Scarcity Call
items.summary: Hines Research says retail pricing has recovered across open-air centers and enclosed malls in the U.S. and Europe, while lagging Asian markets could offer opportunity. About 480M SF of U.S. retail has been demolished since 2000 and development has been slow for over a decade, which Hines calls an underappreciated supply story. Hines frames the opportunity as an income and scarcity call, with returns driven by leasing and execution, and grocery anchors worth about 25% above-market rents in Atlanta.…

items.summary: Mark IV Capital broke ground in October on a 41,521 SF plaza at The District in Round Rock, with six single-story buildings and room for nine to 14 restaurant and lifestyle tenants. The plaza is the project’s second vertical phase and is due in 2028, alongside the 316-unit Origin apartments that began construction in March with $86M in funding.…

items.headline: Retail Vacancy Falls to 4.3% as Q3 Absorption Hits 10.5M SF
items.summary: National retail vacancy fell 10 basis points to 4.3% in Q3, while shopping center vacancy slipped to 5.4% and mall vacancy dropped 30 basis points to 8.2%. Leasing totaled 38.4M SF and net absorption hit 10.5M SF, led by general retail at 5.4M SF, with shopping centers at 3.0M SF and malls at 1.9M SF. Elevated construction and financing costs keep supply tight, with 58.1M SF under construction, and Colliers expects limited development to support measured rent growth through 2026.…

Maxx has signed a lease for 28,837 square feet at Extell Development ’s retail condominium unit at 150 East 86th Street , according to a source close to the deal and a third-quarter Manhattan retail report from CBRE .…

items.headline: Southern California Retail Vacancy Falls to 6.15% in Q3
items.summary: Retail tenants absorbed about 757,600 SF across Los Angeles and Orange counties and the Inland Empire in Q3 2026, while overall vacancy dropped 12 basis points to 6.15%. Orange County vacancy fell 25 basis points to a five-year low of 3.55% with rents up 3% to $2.65 per SF, while the Inland Empire led absorption at 527,000 SF. Los Angeles County lagged with 50,000 SF of absorption, down 77% from Q2, so the recovery is uneven even as community centers lead and construction stays limited.…

items.headline: Bath & Body Works to Open 9K-SF Store in Flatiron District

Bath & Body Works will move into the two-level retail unit, owned by Acadia Realty Trust , in the fall of 2027, according to Crain’s New York Business , which first reported the lease.…

items.headline: Manhattan Retail Availability Hits Record Low as Banks Expand
items.summary: Average availability across Manhattan’s prime retail corridors dropped to 11.4% in Q3 2026, the lowest reading since JLL began tracking in 2017, with only 157 spaces left. Bank of America, OceanFirst and Citibank signed leases totaling nearly 35,000 square feet, and JLL says many more bank deals are pending, adding fresh competition for storefronts.…

items.headline: Miami Retail Pipeline Hits 1.3M SF, Highest Since Early 2023
items.summary: Miami-Dade’s retail pipeline reached 1.3M SF in the third quarter, double last year’s level, as developers gain confidence in a market with 3% direct vacancy. Leasing slowed to 257K SF across 118 deals from 413K SF across 150 deals in Q2, and absorption turned negative, yet triple-net asking rents set a record $44.34 per SF. Heavy preleasing is letting developers underwrite new projects, but vacancy below 3% in core submarkets means tenants must stay flexible to find space.…

items.summary: Udon Shin , a popular Japanese restaurant with only two other U.S. locations, is gearing up to open its first New York City eatery, Commercial Observer has learned. items.summary: Sports apparel retailer Lids is adding another location in New York City, this time inside Midtown’s bustling Pennsylvania Station , Commercial Observer has learned. Lids is the largest licensed sports-minded retailer in North America, with more than 1,300 stores, according to tenant broker JLL .…
